Name: Connected Chests
Author: Thrudam
Description:
[size=5][b]Connected Chests[/b][/size]

Tired of opening chest after chest looking for that one item? With [b]Connected Chests[/b], chests placed next to each other work as a [b]single storage[/b]. Open any of them and you'll see the contents of the whole group, split into pages.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Connected storage:[/b] chests that touch each other (up, down, left, right) are treated as one. Opening one shows all of them.[/*]
[*][b]Open a single chest:[/b] hold [b]Shift[/b] while opening to open only that chest, just like vanilla.[/*]
[*][b]Pages:[/b] switch pages with the [b]mouse wheel[/b], [b]PageUp / PageDown[/b], or [b]LB / RB[/b] on a controller.[/*]
[*][b]Search bar:[/b] click it and type to find items. Matching items move to the first slots and the rest are dimmed. It searches by name and category, and ignores case and accents. Right-click the box to clear it.[/*]
[*][b]Controller compatible:[/b] press [b]R3[/b] (click the right stick) to search using the game's on-screen keyboard. Use [b]LB / RB[/b] to change pages.[/*]
[*][b]Workbench support:[/b] a workbench uses every chest connected to the chests around it, so you can craft with your whole storage.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla buttons work for the whole group:[/b] organize, add to existing stacks, community center bundles, etc.[/*]
[*][b]Translated[/b] into all the game's languages.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
A [b]config.json[/b] file is created in the mod folder the first time you run the game. You can edit it with any text editor:
[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b] (default true): turn the mod on or off without uninstalling it.[/*]
[*][b]IncludeDiagonals[/b] (default false): chests touching diagonally also count as connected.[/*]
[*][b]ExtendWorkbench[/b] (default true): workbenches use the whole chain of connected chests.[/*]
[*][b]MaxChests[/b] (default 64): maximum number of chests in one group.[/*]
[*][b]SingleChestKey[/b] (default LeftShift): hold this to open only one chest.[/*]
[*][b]NextPageKey / PreviousPageKey[/b] (default PageDown, RightShoulder / PageUp, LeftShoulder): keys to change pages.[/*]
[*][b]SearchKey[/b] (default RightStick): opens the search with a controller.[/*]
[/list]Key names follow the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]SMAPI key bindings[/url] format.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Single-player only.[/b] The mod disables itself automatically in multiplayer and split-screen.[/*]
[*]The [b]Organize[/b] button sorts the whole group and refills the chests in order, so items that were kept in specific chests may end up in a different one.[/*]
[*]Junimo chests and fridges are not connected.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
[b]Safe to uninstall:[/b] the mod doesn't store any data in your save, and items always stay in their real chests. Just delete the mod folder.
